weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. Inflicts Def/Res-4 on any foe in a cardinal direction from unit during that foe's combat.

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

Grants another action to target ally. Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-3 and【Guard】on foes in cardinal directions of unit and target through their next actions. (Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance. This skill treated as Sing or Dance.)
【Guard】
Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on unit per attack during combat through its next action. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

Grants another action to target ally. Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5,【Guard】, and【Discord】 on foes in cardinal directions of unit and target ally through their next actions. (Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance. This skill treated as Sing or Dance.)
【Guard】
Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on unit per attack during combat through its next action. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)
【Discord】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-X on unit during combat (X = 2 + number of allies within 2 spaces of unit; max 5) through its next action.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+7, but after combat, if unit attacked, deals 5 damage to unit.

b.d: If unit's HP = 100%, unit can move to a space adjacent to any infantry, armored, or cavalry ally within 2 spaces.
If unit's HP ≥ 50%, unit can move to a space adjacent to any infantry, armored, or cavalry ally within 2 spaces.
Unit can move to a space adjacent to any infantry, armored, or cavalry ally within 2 spaces.
If Sing or Dance is used, grants Spd+2 to target.
If Sing or Dance is used, grants Atk/Spd+2 to target.
If Sing or Dance is used, grants Atk/Spd+3 to target.

If Sing or Dance is used, enables【Canto (１)】on unit and grants Atk/Spd+6 and【Desperation】 to target for 1 turn.
【Canto (１)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move １ space(s).
(Unit moves according to movement type. Once per turn. Cannot attack or assist. Only highest value applied. Does not stack. After moving, if a skill that grants another action would be triggered (like with Galeforce), Canto will trigger after the granted action. Unit's base movement has no effect on movement granted. Cannot warp (using skills like Wings of Mercy) a distance greater than unit would be able to move with normal Canto movement.)
【Desperation】
Grants the following effect for 1 turn: "If unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack."

c.d: Inflicts Spd/Res-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
